title: fix: regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml for @hotcrm/ai dependencies
body:
CI failing on all jobs with `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE` — the `@hotcrm/ai` package was added to the hotcrm submodule but the lockfile was never regenerated to include its dependencies.

- **Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`** with the hotcrm submodule checked out, adding resolution entries for `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/spec`, `axios`, `zod`, and `typescript` required by `examples/hotcrm/packages/ai/package.json`

Single file change. All 8,388 tests pass.
